finalText:
**Fixed. All 625 tests pass.**

Only 3 cases were really broken, all in `orderTotal`. It took the discount off, then charged tax on the *full* price. So the customer paid tax on money they never spent.

Now it taxes the discounted amount, which is what the comment above it already said.

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

Only rows with both a discount and a tax could show this. Most rows had one or the other, so it hid for a long time.
